record.title: Validate a bounded ordered-write transcript consumer
record.intent: Execute only a predeclared finite command transcript while retaining complete access and thread observation.
requirements: Load a bounded versioned immutable transcript before tracing; reject malformed, oversized, inconsistent-count or trailing input before target creation.
Retain exactly the existing two read responses and continuous group observer; accept only exact ordered main-thread32-bit stores at the known PC/opcode and offset0x3000.
Record every accepted operand and pre/post register state; only PC advances, with no memory backing or peripheral effect introduced.

Implement read-only stock binding and table checks before the first modeled write, initialized ADC shadow checks, and terminal ADC shadow captures; private controls exercise good and mismatched binding/state inputs.
Private controls cover a full452-operation sequence, main/worker next access, wrong value/order/offset, count exhaustion, a worker attempting the expected store and a64-bit store.
Re-run existing controls with the rebuilt executable and validate malformed-input rejection before target creation.
Preserve explicit thread/event/count/wall-clock bounds; check runtime deadline even while wait events remain available.
Preserve enforcement/system_server and commit and push controls before stock execution.
acceptance: Independent checks prove ordered prefix/count, unchanged non-PC registers, input and state guards, thread attribution and complete successful cleanup. Unexpected outcomes remain preserved negatives.

review.rationale: Review of revised OPEN contract only. Full452-store inputs, binding/state checks and negative controls match the static decision. No task completion asserted; remain waiting on prerequisite execution.
